crossRefs.note: “ ‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall…
“ ‘This is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which one shall offer to Yahweh:

translations.web: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to Yahweh,
translations.bsb: When you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering or sacrifice to fulfill a vow or as a peace offering to the LORD,
translations.kjv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
translations.asv: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt-offering, or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace-offerings unto Jehovah;
